external_collaboration.evidence_quote: November 26, 2024– Nuseed, the Seed Technologies platform of Nufarm announces a strategic partnership with Unilever, one of the world’s largest consumer goods companies, to promote the technical project development and future downstream commercialization of biomass oil in the fast-moving commercial goods market.

Another of Nuseed’s most successful and long-standing collaborations has been with the Grains Research Development Council (GRDC) and Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organization (CSIRO), Australia’s national science research agency in the development of Nuseed Omega-3 Canola.
